instruction: Add the text "MEMO" as a slide note and apply an orange background.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.scoring_breakdown: 0.5 for correct note text, 0.5 for correct background color
